name: y_qo_edge_test

hypotheses.H003a: qo enrichment after y-final tokens in Biological B beyond within-folio permutation
hypotheses.H003b: the binary y/non-y edge feature captures >=50% of the Currier-B edge-state gain

statistics.R: P(qo|prev y)/P(qo|prev other final), Biological B; within-folio permutation null 1000, seed 20261070
statistics.delta_Sy: folio-mean M0-M_Sy, prefix | {y,other,BOL,UNC}, Currier B, 5-fold cross-fit, backoff coder

decision.H003a: SUPPORTED_DEV iff R>=1.5 and p<=0.01; FALSIFIED_DEV iff R<=1.1 or null q97.5>=R
decision.H003b: SUPPORTED_DEV iff delta_Sy>=0.05 with CI lower>0 and share>=0.5; FALSIFIED_DEV iff CI upper<0.05 or share<0.25

claim_ceiling: Structural transition statistics; no meaning claims.
